description: Label rules for the live fleet reality e2e (scripts/fleet_reality_e2e.py). Rules, not captured data: process_triage is a public repository and fleet command lines are private. Every must_not_act class below was rated P(abandoned)~1.0 by pt 2.1.0 on the 2026-09-24 fleet scan.

must_not_act._comment: Candidates matching these must never be recommended for any action other than keep/review (kill, restart, pause, renice, throttle, freeze, quarantine are all violations). Regexes are matched against the full command line.

should_surface._comment: Informational (not a gate): processes a human would want to see near the top. Reported as recall of these classes among candidates with suspicion score >= 50.
